title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

reading.body:
Waymo autonomous vehicles became stranded on San Francisco streets during Fourth of July celebrations when heavy traffic caused their batteries to drain while stationary. The company attributed this to major traffic disruptions and unplanned road closures that created unexpected congestion in the area. A system deployed without adequate reserves for extreme but foreseeable events, or without a failsafe to vacate congested areas, left vehicles immobilized on public streets.

The incident also revealed a gap in safe operation during emergencies. One vehicle continued driving while fireworks exploded nearby, and another vehicle caught fire after driving over fireworks on the road. These suggest the system did not recognize hazardous conditions or respond to them appropriately, operating in circumstances outside the normal conditions for which it was designed.

It is not established whether Waymo had been warned of the scale of the event beforehand, or what specific safety features or monitoring should have prevented these outcomes.

reports.title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

summary:
Several Waymo autonomous vehicles became stranded on San Francisco streets during Fourth of July celebrations when their batteries drained while stuck in heavy traffic. Video footage showed at least a dozen Waymo vehicles, primarily Jaguar I-PEACE models, lined up stationary on streets following fireworks displays near the Golden Gate Bridge. The company attributed the incident to major traffic disruptions, high traveler volume, and unplanned road closures that caused unexpected congestion. Waymo's roadside assistance team worked to tow away the affected vehicles, and the company stated it is evaluating ways to improve its resilience during major traffic disruptions.

During the event, some passengers experienced concerning moments, including one rider whose Waymo continued driving while fireworks exploded nearby. A Waymo vehicle caught fire after driving over fireworks, though no injuries were reported. San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie acknowledged the post-fireworks traffic delays and urged residents to be patient. The city's emergency management office is planning conversations with public and private partners to improve traffic management for future events, noting that over 100,000 people were in the area and experienced significant delays getting home.
